title: Robinhood’s Crypto Trading Volume Falls 48% in October as Event Contracts More Than Double
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Robinhood’s Crypto Trading Volume Falls 48% in October as Event Contracts More Than Double Robinhood customers traded $17 billion of crypto in October, down 48% from a year earlier, while event contracts traded jumped 136% to 5.9 billion. This post Robinhood’s Crypto Trading Volume Falls 48% in October as Event Contracts More Than Double first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
